name: Ambush
text: When you roll Initiative or a Stealth check, you can spend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll (not while Incapacitated).

name: Bait and Switch
text: On your turn, spend a Superiority Die and 5 feet of movement to swap places with a willing, non-Incapacitated creature within 5 feet (no Opportunity Attacks). Roll the die: you or that creature gains that bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Commander's Strike
text: Replace one of your attacks in the Attack action and spend a Superiority Die to let a willing creature who can see or hear you use its Reaction for a weapon or Unarmed Strike attack, adding the die to the damage.

name: Commanding Presence
text: When you make an Intimidation, Performance or Persuasion check, you can spend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll.

name: Disarming Attack
text: When you hit a creature, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage; the target must succeed on a Strength save or drop one held object of your choice.

name: Distracting Strike
text: When you hit a creature, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage; the next attack against the target by anyone other than you has Advantage if made before the start of your next turn.

name: Evasive Footwork
text: As a bonus action, spend a Superiority Die to take the Disengage action and add the rolled number to your AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Feinting Attack
text: As a bonus action, spend a Superiority Die to feint at a creature within 5 feet; you have Advantage on your next attack against it this turn, and add the die to the damage if it hits.

name: Goading Attack
text: When you hit a creature, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage; the target must succeed on a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the end of your next turn.

name: Lunging Attack
text: As a bonus action, spend a Superiority Die to Dash. If you then move at least 5 feet in a straight line and hit with a melee attack as part of the Attack action this turn, add the die to the damage.

name: Maneuvering Attack
text: When you hit a creature, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage and let a willing creature who can see or hear you use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from your target.

name: Menacing Attack
text: When you hit a creature, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage; the target must succeed on a Wisdom save or be Frightened until the end of your next turn.

name: Parry
text: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, use your Reaction and spend a Superiority Die to reduce the damage by the roll + your Strength or Dexterity modifier.

name: Precision Attack
text: When you miss with an attack roll, spend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll, which may turn the miss into a hit.

name: Pushing Attack
text: When you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage; a Large or smaller target must succeed on a Strength save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

name: Rally
text: As a bonus action, spend a Superiority Die to give an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you Temporary Hit Points equal to the roll + half your Fighter level (round down).

name: Riposte
text: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use your Reaction and spend a Superiority Die to make a melee attack against it; on a hit, add the die to the damage.

name: Sweeping Attack
text: When you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend a Superiority Die to hit a second creature within 5 feet of the target and in your reach: if the original attack roll would hit it, it takes damage equal to the die roll, of the same type.

name: Tactical Assessment
text: When you make a History, Investigation or Insight check, you can spend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll.

name: Trip Attack
text: When you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend a Superiority Die to add it to the damage; a Large or smaller target must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked Prone.
